facts.text: The clone's WaveRunner Xi-A / MXi-A driver supports the models WR204MXI-A, WR204XI-A, WR104MXI-A, WR104XI-A, WR64MXI-A, WR64XI-A, WR62XI-A, WR44MXI-A and WR44XI-A
The WaveRunner 104MXi-A is a 4-channel, 1 GHz member: its constructor sets 4 analog channels, 0 digital channels and _bandwidth = 1e9
The identity response is split on commas into manufacturer (field 0), model (field 1) and firmware revision (field 3)
The clone turns the command header off when it constructs the driver ('CHDR OFF') so every response is a bare value
TriggerModes is the set auto, norm, single, stop
The trigger mode is set with TRMD and queried with TRMD?
The acquisition type is sent with :acquire:type, mapping normal to norm, peak_detect to peak, high_resolution to hres and average to aver
The sample mode is sent with :acquire:mode, mapping real_time to rtim and equivalent_time to etim
The number of averages is sent with :acquire:count and is limited to 1 through 65536
The timebase mode is sent with :timebase:mode, mapping main to main, window to wind, xy to xy and roll to roll
The timebase reference is sent with :timebase:reference, mapping left to left, center to cent and right to righ
The measurement functions of the clone's mapping include frequency, period and voltage_peak_to_peak (sent as vpp)
A waveform measurement query is built as ':measure:<function>? <channel>', for example ':measure:frequency? C1'
A continuous acquisition is stopped with ':stop' (the boolean trigger-continuous setter writes 'run' for true and 'stop' for false)
Analog channels are named C1 through C4
